description: This file defines the DataValidation class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling data validation rules for spreadsheet cells, including types, operators, error styles, and related properties.

classes.name: DataValidation
classes.description: Represents data validation rules for spreadsheet cells, including types, operators, error styles, and prompts.

methods.name: getFormula1
methods.description: Returns the first formula used in data validation.

methods.name: setFormula1
methods.description: Sets the first formula used in data validation.

methods.name: getFormula2
methods.description: Returns the second formula used in data validation.

methods.name: setFormula2
methods.description: Sets the second formula used in data validation.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the validation type.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the validation type.

methods.name: getErrorStyle
methods.description: Returns the error style.

methods.name: setErrorStyle
methods.description: Sets the error style.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used in validation.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the operator used in validation.

methods.name: getAllowBlank
methods.description: Returns whether blank entries are allowed.

methods.name: setAllowBlank
methods.description: Sets whether blank entries are allowed.

methods.name: getShowDropDown
methods.description: Returns whether dropdown is shown.

methods.name: setShowDropDown
methods.description: Sets whether dropdown is shown.

methods.name: getShowInputMessage
methods.description: Returns whether input message is shown.

methods.name: setShowInputMessage
methods.description: Sets whether input message is shown.

methods.name: getShowErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns whether error message is shown.

methods.name: setShowErrorMessage
methods.description: Sets whether error message is shown.

methods.name: getErrorTitle
methods.description: Returns the error title.

methods.name: setErrorTitle
methods.description: Sets the error title.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error message.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error message.

methods.name: getPromptTitle
methods.description: Returns the prompt title.

methods.name: setPromptTitle
methods.description: Sets the prompt title.

methods.name: getPrompt
methods.description: Returns the prompt message.

methods.name: setPrompt
methods.description: Sets the prompt message.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current validation state.

methods.name: getSqref
methods.description: Returns the cell reference(s) associated with the validation.

methods.name: setSqref
methods.description: Sets the cell reference(s) associated with the validation.
